items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Yeah, I remember Buddy Bolden's band. Yeah. I remember Buddy Bolden's band all around from about seven years old.

ctx.x: Do you remember one band from uptown that's supposed to be real early? Buddy Bolden. Do you remember Buddy Bolden?

Yeah, I remember Buddy Bolden's band. Yeah. I remember Buddy Bolden's band all around from about seven years old. I remember Buddy Bolden's band, yeah. Man, you bring it up so damn. Yeah. Remember where you heard them?
Where did they play? Or where did you hear them?
